scope: Full held-out test evaluation of both fixed models; numeric labels 0-5

reporting.model_selection: Frozen minimum-validation-loss checkpoints; test results never select weights or hyperparameters

limitations: Anatomical mapping remains unverified; no label is designated prostate or background.
One training seed and three test patients; repeated timing is not independent training replication.
Test metrics are descriptive; later anatomical attribution requires an independent documented source.
Do not tune models or choose checkpoints from these test results; any future tuning needs a separate evaluation design.
Model-forward timing excludes loading and transfers; case processing times have a separate scope.
Filename/size manifests do not establish immutable input contents.
